item.title: SumcheckPIM: An Efficient HBM-Based PIM Architecture for Linear Complexity Zero Knowledge Proofs
SparsePIM+: Accelerating SpMV on HBM-Based PIM via Logic-Die Accumulators with Opportunistic TSV Utilization
One paper accepted to Journal of Systems Architecture (Journal, SCIE)
item.description: One paper has been accepted to Journal of Systems Architecture. Our paper presents SparsePIM+, an HBM-based PIM architecture for accelerating SpMV kernels using logic-die accmulation. SpasrePIM+ is an extended research work from SparsePIM presented at ICS 2025. SparsePIM+ implements the accumulator logic on the logic die of an HBM stack to further merge the partial sums created on PIM dies. SparsePIM implements an efficient dataflow to the logic-die accumulators by issuing partial results opportunistically through underutilized TSVs.

item.title: Two papers accepted to ICS 2026
item.description: Two papers have been accepted to the ACM International Conference on Supercomputing (ICS) 2026. One paper proposed SumcheckPIM, an efficient HBM-based PIM architecture for sumcheck-based ZKPs. SumcheckPIM employs modular arithmetic units near banks and a Fiat-Shamir unit on a logic die. SumcheckPIM also introduces an efficient DRAM-aware folding mechanism to minimize bank conflicts in PIM operations. SumcheckPIM improves the performance of sumcheck protocols dramatically compared to GPU and CPU baselines. Another paper proposes ACE, an accuracy-aware compute engine for ternary LLM inferences. ACE integrates compact ternary decoding and scaling directly into the GEMM pipeline. An FPGA prototype of ACE demonstrates significant accuracy-aware efficiency gains compared to A100 and H100 baselines.

item.title: One paper accepted to ICS 2025
item.description: One papers was accepted to the ACM International Conference on Supercomputing (ICS) 2025. Our paper proposes SparsePIM, an efficient HBM-based PIM architecture for SpMV kernels. SparsePIM includes an efficient hardware architecture for SpMV computations and a sparse data allocation scheme in DRAM row. SparsePIM also employ software-base optimizations to balance computation burdens acress multiple bank groups. By combiging hardware and software approaches, SparsePIM can improve SpMV computations dramatically on HBM-based PIM architecture.
